name: Angler Associate
description: Tracks the daily EOD fishing bounty, shows what's catchable right now based on the day/night cycle, and helps you browse fish by region or find out what you can catch at a specific fishing hole - including exactly where to go and the nearest waypoint to get there.

account.details: Used to authenticate the API key.

progression.details: Used to read fisher achievements progress (so that you can exclude fish you've already caught).
